# Implementation plan

Status: proposed, in progress, or complete.

## Outcome

State the user-visible result and what must be true for it to count as complete. Link the relevant product requirement and note any deliberate scope choice.

## Steps and ownership

List dependent steps in order. For delegated work, assign exclusive paths and name the owner of shared contracts, migrations, and build files.

## Verification

List the automated and manual checks to run. Record the actual outcomes, including any checks that require a phone, launcher, or live provider.

## Step records

For each completed step, record the date, outcome, checks and results, and any blocker or next action. If sessions work in parallel, name the session branch so others can find the work. Include the record in the same commit as the step. Push it to GitHub immediately, merge it into `main`, and verify that both the change and its record are on GitHub `main`. [Git session workflow](../codex-setup.md#session-workflow)

## Handoff

Record completed work, open decisions, and the next action.
